reviewMethod: All 75 actual stored files were independently rehashed, checked for task/page/article/source DOI and content-addressed R2 identity, checked against complete stage-index cross-DOI/figure duplicates, raster-decoded or XML-parsed and SVG-rendered, then individually viewed on all 28 labelled contact sheets against original captions and current paper titles. SVG transparency was composited onto white only for inspection; original published bytes are unchanged. These are new-generation captures, not old sealed images. No publisher recrawl, new scope decision, automatic marker approval or all-article completeness claim.
quality: 68 SVG contain vector structure; 23 of those also contain embedded raster elements. Seven PNG are captured 520px-wide versions, not publisher-maximum-resolution claims. None replaces an existing correct image or TOC.
